name: PAM (Photographic Artificial Memory): Alpha/Hive Standalone Component Functionality Benchmark v0.1
description: Alpha / Hive standalone component benchmark for PAM (photographic artificial memory), frozen run run_20260925T173451347Z, status PASS_BOUNDED_FUNCTIONALITY. The archive holds the preregistration, the benchmark runner and its test, and the run outputs: metrics summary, per-component series, per-agent summary, and the run manifest. Nineteen active Hive agent labels each receive the same neutral synthetic packet. Eight components are scored: disabled control, Triple V security, boundary field, relative DPA, creativity boundary, sensory boundary, synthetic affect, and environment awareness. Each component is checked for the declared decision, deterministic replay, provenance, and effect limits. The summary table reports pass/fail, replay match, mean and p95 microseconds, and serialized bytes. Evaluation license: LICENSE-EVAL.md.
